controller.input: uniform independent permutations of the fixed quota multiset, separately per cascade wave
controller.offline_online_split: Discover and replay strict continuations offline; only exact immutable proof lookups, edge verification and witness execution online in this experiment. No full online solver.
controller.safe_verdicts: completed stable terminal with target satisfied, or a stabilized successor with a verified full Strict continuation. Database nonmembership is unresolved.

m3.dataset: the original 200 independent confirmation boards, 50 per recipe
m3.unit: same starting board, agent choice rule and per-decision proposal stream; game states can diverge after differing refills
m3.cache_isolation: each controller only sees its own memo; the nonsemantic immutable offline proof catalog is common

adoption_screen.primary: ACR versus Fixed6, paired boards and reported separately for cold and warm
adoption_screen.interpretation: local engineering screen for a candidate, not a production release or a real-service SLA

m5.calibration: the original 100 boards, separate gameplay RNG seed
m5.validation: the original tier-pool 200 holdout boards, disjoint from M3 and the calibration boards
m5.formula: mean of Random P(leave >=1 move), P(total clears >=Q+3), P(any swap has >=2 waves) under the ACR controller
m5.cutoffs: midpoints after observations 33 and 66 of the ordered original-100 controller-specific scores; the pre-existing Witness V1 remains untouched
m5.comparison: controller-specific tier coverage, migration vs the previous frozen Witness bins, and within-recipe cross-agent performance
